topic: That grinding sound when you turn the key might be a worn starter

beats.narration: That grinding sound when you turn the key isn't your imagination.
beats.visualPrompt: Interior POV shot of an ignition/key cylinder area, no hand in frame, dashboard focus, morning light through a windshield, static-mounted camera.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: It only happens for that one second of cranking — then the engine runs fine.
beats.visualPrompt: Cutaway to an engine bay wide shot with a subtle vibration/shudder cue timed to an implied grinding sound, then a quick cut to a dashboard tachometer needle settling to a smooth idle.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: One clue: a worn starter gear not meshing clean with the flywheel.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a starter motor's drive-gear (bendix) assembly removed and resting on a workbench, visible wear on the gear teeth, slow push-in, shop lighting.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Ignore it, and those flywheel teeth can wear too — then it may not start at all.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro shot of a flywheel ring gear with visible worn/chipped teeth on a section, static mount, dim shop-bay lighting for emphasis.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Don't guess. A quick check can catch it before you're stuck.
beats.visualPrompt: Underbody/engine-bay inspection shot: an inspection light or diagnostic tool positioned near the starter motor's mounting location, tool visible mounted/clipped, no hand in frame, shop bay softly blurred behind.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Worth checking before one grind turns into a no-start. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Logo and CTA text composited in post, not AI-generated.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

approvedPhrasesUsed: stop by and we'll take a look

posting.caption: Hear a grind right when you turn the key, then it runs fine? One clue mechanics check: a worn starter gear not meshing clean with the flywheel. Ignore it and it can eventually leave you stuck. Don't guess — stop by and we'll take a look.
